notes: Hand-authored workspace-default binding for the Statement of Work (Draft) v1 shell. The body of the document is intentionally legal-team boilerplate — the AI does not author SOW prose; we only stub the engagement metadata via {{tokens}} so the legal team starts from a populated skeleton. Each entry maps a single engine output to a {{token}} that appears verbatim in one <w:t> run inside word/document.xml; the docx filler does a flat string replace, so split runs would silently miss. seed: {"name":"Statement of Work (Draft)","version":"v1","kind":"SOW_DRAFT"}
